verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of choosing a storage region or data residency for AgentMail inboxes or messages. The only related signal is a community comment praising an enterprise "Bring Your Own Cloud" option. That is a deployment model, an adjacent capability, and nothing in the evidence says it lets customers select a region or residency.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
